discovery.en: The discovery of phosphate on Christmas Island transformed the island into an economic resource.
discovery.zh: 圣诞岛上磷酸盐的发现使该岛变成了经济资源。

discovery.en: And Marie Curie… her discoveries laid the foundations for so many other things.
discovery.zh: 而玛丽·居里……她的发现为如此之多的其他领域奠定了基础。

discovery.en: In part two, we will talk about the discovery of the blueprint of life: DNA.
discovery.zh: 在第二部分，我们将谈论生命蓝图的发现：DNA。

discovery.en: This is A&E's Flip This House. Discovery had the cleverly titled, Flip That House.
discovery.zh: 这是A&E频道的《翻修这栋房子》。Discovery频道也有个名字很巧妙的节目叫《翻新那栋房子》（Flip That House）。

discovery.en: The answer to this question goes back to the discovery of the island by European sailors.
discovery.zh: 这个问题的答案可以追溯到欧洲水手对该岛的发现。

directly.en: Petra is famous for its buildings carved directly into pink and red sandstone cliffs.
directly.zh: 佩特拉以其直接雕刻在粉红色和红色砂岩悬崖上的建筑而闻名。

directly.en: Those directly involved in the July 20th plot included nationalists, democrats, aristocrats and communists.
directly.zh: 直接参与7月20日阴谋的人包括民族主义者、民主主义者、贵族和共产主义者。

directly.en: A glove puppet, on the other hand, sits directly on the performer's hand.
directly.zh: 相比之下，手套木偶（glove puppet）直接套在表演者的手上。

directly.en: In 2017, he left Westminster to become the directly elected mayor of Greater Manchester.
directly.zh: 2017年，他离开威斯敏斯特，当选为大曼彻斯特的直选市长。

directly.en: Bush, George Bush senior, were elected directly following their term as Vice President.
directly.zh: 布什，也就是老布什，是在副总统任期结束后直接当选总统的。

direction.en: In terms of possible directions, there are several paths the EU could take.
direction.zh: 就可能的发展方向而言，欧盟有几条路径可供选择。

direction.en: Impulse control. I'm in a tube. There is only one direction I can go.
direction.zh: 冲动控制。我身处管子之中，我只能向一个方向前进。

direction.en: And then he directed in a positive generative direction and he took off.
direction.zh: 然后他把它引向了一个积极的、创造性的方向，然后他就起飞了。

direction.en: It's like, okay, we have at least a direction to move in.
direction.zh: 就像是，好吧，我们至少有一个前进的方向。

direction.en: It's definitely in that direction. And I don't have, I like pets.
direction.zh: 确实有这种倾向。我并不讨厌宠物，我喜欢动物。

dislike.en: And worse, it makes science a turn-off – something that people dislike or find uninteresting.
dislike.zh: 更糟糕的是，它让科学变得令人扫兴——人们不喜欢或觉得无趣的东西。

dislike.en: If something puts you off, it causes you to dislike it or lose interest.
dislike.zh: 如果某事 puts you off，它会让你讨厌它或失去兴趣。

dislike.en: Yes, and what parents usually find out is that the food they dislike isn't inherently bad.
dislike.zh: 是的，父母通常发现的是，他们讨厌的食物本身并不糟糕。

dislike.en: Why do children tend to dislike certain flavours but start to enjoy them as young adults?
dislike.zh: 为什么孩子们往往讨厌某些味道，但在青年时期却开始喜欢它们？

dislike.en: In Claire's clinic, she masks the disliked foods with something that is liked.
dislike.zh: 在克莱尔的诊所里，她用人们喜欢的食物来掩盖那些不喜欢的食物。

disgust.en: For example, I made some soup the other day and I was a bit heavy-handed with the salt – it tasted disgusting!
disgust.zh: 例如，我前几天做了一些汤，结果盐放得有点重——尝起来太难以下咽了！

disgust.en: And it's this disgusting war scene, right?
disgust.zh: 那是一个令人作呕的战争场景，对吧？

disgust.en: They'll say, "That's disgusting! Put it down."
disgust.zh: 他们会说：'太恶心了！快放下。'

disgust.en: It wasn’t because they had bad intentions, but because of something more uncomfortable: they found the working class sort of disgusting, their smell, their manners, their way of life.
disgust.zh: 这倒不是因为他们有什么坏心思，而是因为某种更让人不舒服的原因：他们觉得工人阶级有点恶心，他们的气味、他们的礼貌、他们的生活方式。

disgust.en: This wasn’t one homogenous group with a clear, unified aim for post-Hitler Germany, nor is it fair to characterise them as some great upstanding group of moral citizens who were disgusted by the behaviour of the Nazis.
disgust.zh: 这不是一个有着清晰、统一目标的战后德国愿景的同质化群体，把他们描述为对纳粹行为感到厌恶的伟大高尚道德公民群体也是不公平的。

display.en: They argue that displaying it allows people from around the world to learn about different cultures.
display.zh: 他们认为，将其展出可以让来自世界各地的人们了解不同的文化。

display.en: Across the world museums display artifacts taken from colonized or occupied societies.
display.zh: 世界各地的博物馆都陈列着从被殖民或被占领社会掠夺来的文物。

display.en: And this wasn’t all stashed away in Swiss bank accounts; there were lavish displays of wealth and opulence.
display.zh: 这些钱并非全都藏在瑞士银行的账户里，他还大肆炫耀财富和奢华。

display.en: Some cars do this with animations – displays of moving images.
display.zh: 有些汽车通过动画来实现这一点——即移动图像的显示。

display.en: An animation is a display made up of moving images.
display.zh: 动画是由移动图像组成的显示。

division.en: Now, you might be listening to this thinking “Well, my country has divisions too”.
division.zh: 听到这里，你可能会想：“其实我所在的国家也有地域差异。”

division.en: But if you look at who is voting, the division becomes even clearer.
division.zh: 但如果你看看谁在投票，这种分歧就更加明显了。

division.en: It is also, I should add, part of a three-part mini-series we’re making on British divisions.
division.zh: 我还想补充一点，这也是我们关于英国内部隔阂的三集迷你系列节目之一。

division.en: This political fragmentation, this division, across Germany had lasted for centuries.
division.zh: 这种整个德国的政治碎片化和分裂，已经持续了几个世纪。

division.en: This division is not some ancient accident of geography.
division.zh: 这种划分并非某种古老的地理偶然。

dive.en: He was photographed riding horses shirtless, diving into icy waters, and piloting fighter jets.
dive.zh: 镜头记录下他赤膊骑马、冬泳以及驾驶战斗机的画面。

dive.en: The major objective was allowing people to dive down and recover valuables from shipwrecks.
dive.zh: 主要目标是让人类能够潜入水下并从沉船中打捞贵重物品。

dive.en: And it's worthwhile to spend time in that exploration before diving into exploitation.
dive.zh: 在投入开发之前，花时间进行那种探索是值得的。

dive.en: These things attract many visitors interested in wildlife and diving.
dive.zh: 这些吸引了许多对野生动物和潜水感兴趣的游客。

dive.en: By the Middle Ages, tales from French and German poetry spoke of a hero using a ‘ diving bell’ to explore the ocean’s depths.
dive.zh: 到了中世纪，法国和德国诗歌中的故事讲述了一位英雄利用“潜水钟”来探索海洋深处。

disagreement.en: Divided means in disagreement with and separated from others – to not be together.
disagreement.zh: Divided 的意思是与他人产生分歧并疏离——不再团结。

disagreement.en: But its structure, especially the power of the permanent members, often leads to debate and disagreement.
disagreement.zh: 但它的结构，特别是常任理事国权力，常常引发辩论和分歧。

disagreement.en: For example, countries like the UAE have been in a disagreement with countries like Saudi Arabia.
disagreement.zh: 例如，像阿联酋这样的国家与沙特阿拉伯等国一直存在分歧。

disagreement.en: Much of this disagreement is about the use of performance-enhancing drugs themselves.
disagreement.zh: 这种分歧很大程度上是关于使用兴奋剂本身。

disagreement.en: There were major disagreements between Singapore’s government and Malaysia’s federal government.
disagreement.zh: 新加坡政府与马来西亚联邦政府之间存在重大分歧。

discussion.en: There are also refocusing questions, which are really useful when a discussion goes off track.
discussion.zh: 还有重新聚焦类问题，当讨论偏离正题时，这类问题真的非常有用。

discussion.en: And of course, Britain was not and has not been having these discussions in isolation.
discussion.zh: 当然，英国过去没有、现在也并非孤立地进行这些讨论。

discussion.en: Discussions about food and hunting. Around the fire at night, the topics were very different.
discussion.zh: 关于食物和狩猎的讨论。到了夜里围坐在火堆旁，话题就大不相同了。

discussion.en: It adds something. It helps the discussion develop instead of stopping it.
discussion.zh: 它能带来新的内容。它有助于讨论的深入开展，而不是让对话陷入僵局。

discussion.en: Finally, get AI to give you a discussion question about the episode topic, and practise answering it.
discussion.zh: 最后，让人工智能给你出一个关于节目主题的讨论问题，并练习回答它。

disorder.en: The current consensus is that George III is likely to have had bipolar disorder.
disorder.zh: 目前的共识是，George III 很可能患有双相情感障碍。

disorder.en: Specifically, bipolar disorder type one, the kind characterised by full manic episodes.
disorder.zh: 具体来说是一型双相情感障碍，其特征是全面的躁狂发作。

disorder.en: Earlier we mentioned PTSD and it stands for post-traumatic stress disorder.
disorder.zh: 我们前面提到的PTSD代表post-traumatic stress disorder（创伤后应激障碍）。

disorder.en: Some zoologists have compared zoochosis to human traumas like post-traumatic stress disorder but say it's even more damaging.
disorder.zh: 一些动物学家将动物园精神病与人类创伤（如创伤后应激障碍）进行比较，但表示它的危害更大。

disorder.en: The results of the starvation experiment were eventually published and remain an important academic reference on nutrition, famine and eating disorders.
disorder.zh: 这项饥饿实验的结果最终得以发表，并至今仍是营养学、饥荒和进食障碍领域重要的学术参考资料。

disagree.en: One example of a kind of production that degrowthers disagree with is fast fashion.
disagree.zh: “减增长主义者”反对的一种生产方式就是快时尚。

disagree.en: Different countries, different members of the EU, disagreed with how to solve the problems.
disagree.zh: 不同的国家、欧盟不同的成员国，对于如何解决问题有着不同的意见。

disagree.en: Instead of interrupting or disagreeing, you can use questions to bring the focus back.
disagree.zh: 与其打断或表示反对，你可以用问题把焦点拉回来。

disagree.en: So, how can we be more open to getting to know people that we might disagree with?
disagree.zh: 那么，我们该如何更开放地去结识那些我们可能并不认同的人呢？

disagree.en: Being a wine judge, David, of course disagrees, using the phrase, but I would say that, wouldn't I?
disagree.zh: 作为一名葡萄酒评委，David 当然不同意这种说法，他用了一句话：'我当然会这么说，不是吗？'

discover.en: And, what’s more, Machu Picchu was discovered high in the hills of Peru in 1911.
discover.zh: 而且，更重要的是，1911 年在秘鲁的高山中发现了马丘比丘。

discover.en: Although it may have been discovered earlier by people from the Indonesian islands, perhaps.
discover.zh: 尽管它可能更早之前就被来自印尼群岛的人们发现了，也许吧。

discover.en: In fact, Hardy once said that his greatest contribution to mathematics was discovering Ramanujan.
discover.zh: 事实上，Hardy曾说过，他对数学最大的贡献就是发现了Ramanujan。

discover.en: Later that same year, they discovered radium a substance far more radioactive than uranium.
discover.zh: 同年晚些时候，他们发现了镭（radium），这是一种放射性远超铀的物质。

discover.en: In the late 1960s, large oil and gas reserves were discovered underneath the North Sea.
discover.zh: 在20世纪60年代后期，人们在北海下方发现了巨大的石油和天然气储量。

dip.en: For one, give children a choice – for example, by offering small, healthy snacks and dips before the meal.
dip.zh: 首先，给孩子一个选择——例如，在饭前提供小份的健康零食和蘸酱。

dip.en: One famous study found that people’s tweets tended to be more positive in the morning, dip during the workday, and then rise again in the evening.
dip.zh: 一项著名的研究发现，人们的推文在早晨往往更积极，在工作期间会下降，然后在晚上再次上升。

dip.en: One of the really good techniques that we might use is something called masking, where you dip a food that you don't like into something that you do like.
dip.zh: 我们可以使用的一个非常好的技巧叫做掩盖法，就是把你不太喜欢的食物蘸在你喜欢的食物里。

dip.en: And then anger dipping into pain and anguish and then crying it out and then being angry again and then being scared and then just going through waves and waves and waves of that.
dip.zh: 然后愤怒陷入痛苦和苦恼，然后哭出来，然后再次愤怒，然后害怕，然后经历一波又一波的浪潮。

dip.en: Definitely the tortilla chip. Why? Because you could do so many things – dip it in almost everything, adding some guacamole,spicy salsa or just sour cream with a mixture of chipotle sauce.
dip.zh: 绝对是玉米片。为什么？因为你可以做很多尝试——几乎可以蘸任何东西，加点牛油果酱（guacamole）、辣萨尔萨酱，或者只是酸奶油混合烟熏辣椒酱。

distress.en: Many of them were deeply distressed by what they were doing.
distress.zh: 他们中很多人对自己正在做的事感到极度痛苦。

distress.en: After all, the teachers had been deeply distressed.
distress.zh: 毕竟，那些“教师”们经历了深深的痛苦。

distress.en: He appeared thin and clearly distressed.
distress.zh: 他看起来很消瘦，明显十分痛苦。

distress.en: With a regular income, debt can be managed, but for those who are unemployed or on low incomes, it can cause serious distress.
distress.zh: 如果有稳定的收入，债务是可以管理的，但对于失业或低收入的人来说，它会造成严重的痛苦。

distress.en: Many studies and research have shown that many animals in zoos and aquariums display abnormal behaviours like head-bobbing, pacing, stereotypical behaviours, signs of mental distress.
distress.zh: 许多研究表明，动物园和水族馆里的许多动物会表现出异常行为，如反复点头、踱步、刻板行为以及精神痛苦的迹象。

dioxide.en: If you sequester something, such as carbon dioxide, you remove it and store it.
dioxide.zh: sequester 某样东西，比如二氧化碳，意思就是把它清除并储存起来。

dioxide.en: She also mentions how scientists have ruled out that TRAPPIST-1e is full of hydrogen or carbon dioxide.
dioxide.zh: 她还提到科学家是如何排除 TRAPPIST-1e 充满氢气或二氧化碳的可能性的。

dioxide.en: Alongside sharks, another species that Trisha believes is important to helping remove carbon dioxide from the atmosphere is the wildebeest.
dioxide.zh: 除了鲨鱼，Trisha 认为角马也是有助于从大气中清除二氧化碳的重要物种。

dioxide.en: You can be outside too. Yeah, if it's until the carbon dioxide parts per million are below this particular number, it's like, that's a...
dioxide.zh: 你也可以在外面。是的，如果是“直到二氧化碳浓度低于这个特定数值”，那就像是……

dioxide.en: Scientists have been looking at the potential atmosphere around TRAPPIST-1e and they've ruled out that it's really full of hydrogen or carbon dioxide, which is a great thing because they're greenhouse gases, which would make the planet really hot.
dioxide.zh: 科学家们一直在研究 TRAPPIST-1e 周围的潜在大气层，他们已经排除了它充满氢气或二氧化碳的可能性，这太棒了，因为它们是温室气体，会让行星变得非常热。

dismiss.en: The phrasal verb rule out means to dismiss the possibility or idea of something.
dismiss.zh: 短语动词 rule out 意为排除某种可能性或想法。

dismiss.en: In the past, those in power often dismissed protestors as dangerous or unrealistic.
dismiss.zh: 在过去，当权者经常把抗议者斥为危险分子或不切实际。

dismiss.en: The phrasal verb rule out means to dismiss the possibility or idea of something.
dismiss.zh: 短语动词 rule out 意为排除某种可能性或想法。

dismiss.en: The workhouse master was dismissed. There were some minor changes to the law.
dismiss.zh: 这名济贫院主管被解雇了。法律做了一些小幅修改。

dismiss.en: This idea has been debated for decades and for a long time it was dismissed as impossible.
dismiss.zh: 这个观点已经争论了几十年，很长一段时间里它都被认为是不可能的而遭到否定。

diet.en: Bread, a staple of the Egyptian diet, became a luxury for some families.
diet.zh: 面包，这个埃及人日常饮食的主食，对某些家庭来说已经成了一种奢侈品。

diet.en: And we know that diets are the single largest cause of health inequalities in the UK.
diet.zh: 而且我们知道，饮食是英国健康不平等的最单一最大成因。

diet.en: A sweet treat. Diet, exercise, and eating in moderation helps some people stay at a healthy weight.
diet.zh: 甜食的诱惑。饮食、运动和适度进食能帮助一些人保持健康的体重。

diet.en: The experiment - the volunteers had to go on a starvation diet.
diet.zh: 这项实验要求志愿者们遵循饥饿饮食法。

diet.en: Did you follow your diet? Well, I did for half the month.
diet.zh: 你遵循你的饮食计划了吗？嗯，我遵循了一半。

disrupt.en: And this has really disrupted energy supplies and shipping routes.
disrupt.zh: 这确实扰乱了能源供应和航运路线。

disrupt.en: The European arrival also disrupted traditional ways of life.
disrupt.zh: 欧洲人的到来也打乱了他们传统的生活方式。

disrupt.en: Sometimes I would just disrupt anything.
disrupt.zh: 有时我只是破坏任何事情。

disrupt.en: Violence destroys infrastructure. It disrupts education.
disrupt.zh: 暴力摧毁了基础设施。它扰乱了教育。

disrupt.en: It could even disrupt the delicate conditions that make life on Earth possible, such as our climate and the length of the seasons.
disrupt.zh: 它甚至可能破坏使地球生命成为可能的微妙条件，例如我们的气候和季节的长度。

diesel.en: Carbon emissions from food production make up around a third of all greenhouse gases, from the diesel used to drive tractors, to fertilisers, to cows and sheep producing methane.
diesel.zh: 粮食生产产生的碳排放约占所有温室气体的三分之一，从驱动拖拉机的柴油、化肥，到产生甲烷的牛羊。

disappear.en: Tituba, who’d confessed, was sold to a new owner and disappeared from the records.
disappear.zh: 曾经认罪的蒂图芭被卖给了一位新主人，从此在记录中消失了。

disappear.en: I just disappear. My wife knows not to ever book or schedule me for anything.
disappear.zh: 我只是消失。我妻子知道永远不要帮我预订或安排任何事情。

disappear.en: A culture that has evolved but never completely disappeared, then China is a strong contender.
disappear.zh: 一个已经演变但从未完全消失的文化，那么中国是一个强有力的竞争者。

disappear.en: The old logic of Françafrique might not have disappeared completely, but it has shifted.
disappear.zh: “法属非洲”的旧逻辑或许尚未完全消失，但已经发生了转变。

disappear.en: Thirty seconds later, it is over. One man has disappeared into a nearby photography studio.
disappear.zh: 三十秒后，一切结束了。一名男子已经躲进了附近的照相馆。

dilemma.en: Which shows, if nothing else, what a true dilemma this is — to quit or not to quit.
dilemma.zh: 这至少表明了，放弃还是不放弃，这是一个多么真实的两难境地。

dilemma.en: It relates to Clayton Christensen and The Innovator's Dilemma, which you've talked about recently on the program.
dilemma.zh: 它和克莱顿·克里斯坦森以及《创新者的窘境》有关，你最近在节目里也谈到过这本书。

dilemma.en: She says there was an angel on one shoulder and a devil on the other, an old idiom which describes having a personal dilemma.
dilemma.zh: 她说自己“肩膀上一边是天使，另一边是恶魔”，这是一个古老的习语，用来形容陷入个人抉择的困境。

dilemma.en: In game theory, the most famous game is Prisoner's Dilemma, but that's all about everybody cheating and the Nash equilibrium, the stable equilibrium there is everybody cheats.
dilemma.zh: 在博弈论中，最著名的游戏是囚徒困境，但那全关乎每个人都作弊，那里的纳什均衡、稳定均衡就是每个人都作弊。

dilemma.en: The idiom, an angel on one shoulder and a devil on the other describes a personal dilemma where someone must choose whether to follow their conscience or not.
dilemma.zh: 习语“肩膀上一边是天使，另一边是恶魔”描述了一种个人抉择的困境，即人们必须选择是否听从自己的良知。

disease.en: Diseases, especially smallpox, which was brought from Europe, spread through the city, killing thousands.
disease.zh: 疾病（尤其是从欧洲带过去的天花）在城中蔓延，夺去了成千上万人的生命。

disease.en: In 1901, there was an outbreak of a disease linked to malnutrition and vitamin deficiency.
disease.zh: 1901 年，爆发了一种与营养不良和维生素缺乏有关的疾病。

disease.en: No one knows exactly what happened. Some guess they succumbed to disease or starvation.
disease.zh: 没有人确切知道发生了什么。有人猜测他们死于疾病或饥饿。

disease.en: Earthquakes were another danger. And also diseases regularly spread through the crowded population.
disease.zh: 地震是另一个危险。此外，疾病也经常在拥挤的人群中蔓延。

disease.en: They brought with them diseases to which the Rapa Nui had no immunity.
disease.zh: 他们带来了 Rapa Nui 人毫无免疫力的疾病。

differ.en: Gunhild Sætren First and foremost, I would say that perhaps the gender differs.
differ.zh: Gunhild Sætren：首先，我想说，也许性别存在差异。

differ.en: And how does the political system in the UK differ from that in your country?
differ.zh: 英国的政治体系与你国家的政治体系有何不同？

differ.en: Another important way in which cultures differ is something called “time orientation”.
differ.zh: 时间取向指的是一种文化更喜欢关注时间的哪一部分：过去、现在还是未来。

differ.en: They are a way to be polite in social settings, and because politeness and sensitivity are cultural things (what is considered polite or rude differs between cultures) euphemisms reflect cultural attitudes about what is considered appropriate or respectful to say in public.
differ.zh: 它们是在社交场合中保持礼貌的一种方式，而且由于礼貌和敏感度因文化而异（什么被认为是礼貌或粗鲁在不同文化中有所不同），委婉语反映了公众认为哪些言论得体或尊重的文化态度。

distance.en: They observed birds knowing that some species only fly a certain distance from shore.
distance.zh: 他们观察鸟类，知道某些物种只在离海岸一定距离的范围内飞行。

distance.en: And there was the physical and psychological distance from the person being harmed.
distance.zh: 此外，还有与受害者之间物理上和心理上的距离感。

distance.en: ' to rephrase a question more informally, particularly one about distance, cost or numbers.
distance.zh: ……以更口语化的方式重新表达一个问题，尤其适用于关于距离、花费或数字的问题。

distance.en: And finally, remote means at a large distance from places where other people live.
distance.zh: 最后，偏远（remote）的意思是距离其他人居住的地方非常遥远。

distance.en: They settled on islands that were separated by vast distances of open water.
distance.zh: 他们在被广阔开阔水域隔开的岛屿上定居。

distinctive.en: OK. I like... Some scientists think zebras' distinctive black-and-white stripes prevent bites from flies and other insects.
distinctive.zh: 好的。我喜欢……一些科学家认为，斑马独特的黑白条纹可以防止苍蝇和其他昆虫的叮咬。

distinctive.en: And finally, a scent is a distinctive smell, often a pleasant one although it can also mean the smell made by an animal.
distinctive.zh: 最后，“scent”是一种独特的香味，通常是令人愉悦的，尽管它也可以指动物产生的气味。

distinctive.en: These peppers have strong, distinctive tastes, but curiously they enhance rather than overpower the flavour of the food you're eating, as Mathilde explained to BBC World Service programme The Food Chain.
distinctive.zh: 这些胡椒具有浓郁而独特的风味，但奇怪的是，它们提升了食物的风味，而不是掩盖它，正如 Mathilde 对 BBC World Service 节目《The Food Chain》所解释的那样。

disguise.en: Some bombs were disguised as parcels, others as pieces of scientific equipment.
disguise.zh: 有些炸弹伪装成包裹，有些伪装成科学仪器。

disguise.en: It will not disguise the other ingredients, but it will push them – it's a flavour catalyst.
disguise.zh: 它不会掩盖其他食材，而是会推动它们——它是一种风味催化剂。

disguise.en: In late 1917, he traveled in disguise to the town of Deraa, deep in Ottoman-controlled territory.
disguise.zh: 1917 年底，他乔装打扮前往奥斯曼控制区深处的德拉镇。

disguise.en: But seen from a distance in the snowy mountain forests where they live, black and white makes the perfect disguise.
disguise.zh: 但如果从它们居住的白雪皑皑的山林远眺，黑白两色就成了完美的伪装。

disguise.en: So, he returns not in the clothes of a triumphant king, but disguised as a poor beggar clad in rags.
disguise.zh: 因此，他回来时没有穿着凯旋国王的衣服，而是伪装成一个衣衫褴褛的穷乞丐。

dine.en: I am supporting the meme 'breakfast like a king and dine like a pauper '.
dine.zh: 我支持“早餐吃得像国王，晚餐吃得像乞丐”这个观点。

dine.en: Alexandra says that you should 'breakfast like a king and dine like a pauper '.
dine.zh: Alexandra说你应该“早餐吃得像国王，晚餐吃得像乞丐”。

dine.en: At the time, she ran the dining services department at a senior living facility.
dine.zh: 当时，她在一家高级生活护理中心管理餐饮服务部门。

dine.en: Brandy carried the card in case she needed to buy dining supplies for work.
dine.zh: Brandy 随身带着这张卡，以防她需要为工作购买餐饮用品。

dine.en: Open dormitories. Shared dining halls with long, visible sight lines.
dine.zh: 开放式宿舍。共享的餐厅，视线长且一览无余。

discipline.en: And, I'm not saying we should. I mean, it's become a very technical discipline.
discipline.zh: 我不是说我们应该有更多哲学家。我是说，经济学已经变成了一门非常技术化的学科。

discipline.en: And related to this story is I think understanding is way more important than discipline.
discipline.zh: 与这个故事相关的是，我认为理解远比纪律重要。

discipline.en: Now, Jocko would have a fit. But, you know, on physical things, discipline is important.
discipline.zh: 现在，Jocko可能会发火。但是，在身体层面，纪律很重要。

discipline.en: As we'll hear, it's an extremely demanding sport which requires discipline, stamina and years of training.
discipline.zh: 正如我们将要听到的，这是一项要求极高的运动，需要自律、耐力和多年的训练。

discipline.en: On the other hand, they were highly trained and disciplined soldiers who were feared on the battlefield.
discipline.zh: 另一方面，他们是训练有素、纪律严明的士兵，在战场上令人闻风丧胆。

disaster.en: People who live in areas affected by natural disasters can often experience climate trauma.
disaster.zh: 生活在受自然灾害影响地区的人，常常会经历'气候创伤'(climate trauma)。

disaster.en: And natural disasters hit poorer communities hardest because they have fewer resources to recover.
disaster.zh: 自然灾害对较贫困社区打击最大，因为他们拥有的恢复资源更少。

disaster.en: Skipping grades might have made academic sense, but socially it was a disaster.
disaster.zh: 跳级在学业上可能合乎情理，但在社交上却是一场灾难。

disaster.en: So, the reasons include nuclear tensions, AI risk, climate disaster – essentially any world-ending event.
disaster.zh: 原因包括核紧张局势、人工智能风险、气候灾难——基本上是任何毁灭世界的事件。

disaster.en: Now, natural disasters like floods and wildfires can destroy homes and communities.
disaster.zh: 洪水、野火这类自然灾害会摧毁家园和社区。

digital.en: They don’t look very exciting, but they are the backbone of the modern digital world.
digital.zh: 它们看起来不怎么起眼，但它们是现代数字世界的顶梁柱。

digital.en: The Union could push for digital innovation and the regulation of big tech.
digital.zh: 欧盟可以推动数字创新以及对大型科技公司的监管。

digital.en: Millennial and digital native Kyle Chayka is a writer specialising in social media.
digital.zh: 千禧一代和数字原住民 Kyle Chayka 是一位专门研究社交媒体的作家。

digital.en: Claude Shannon laid the intellectual foundations for much of the digital revolution.
digital.zh: 克劳德·香农为数字革命的大部分理论奠定了基础。

digital.en: Tracking behavior in apps or on websites does not necessarily prevent harmful behavior in digital spaces.
digital.zh: 在应用程序中或网站上追踪行为并不一定能防止数字空间中的有害行为。

discourse.en: Oh man! I mean... In 2015/2016, I think, in the United States, when Twitter became the hub of election discourse, it kind of shattered the illusion that the internet was a space you could go to, just like, have fun and express yourself and find cool friends and discuss the latest cultural happenings.
discourse.zh: 噢，天哪！我是说……我想是在 2015/2016 年的美国，当 Twitter 成为选举讨论的中心时，它在某种程度上打破了那种幻觉，即互联网是一个你可以去玩耍、表达自我、结交酷朋友并讨论最新文化事件的地方。

director.en: And yet, 90% of you are not going to get to be managing directors.
director.zh: 可最终，你们中90%的人是当不上董事总经理的。

director.en: Our unsung hero this week is Seung Kim. Seung is a senior director with the Local Initiatives Support Coalition.
director.zh: 我们本周的无名英雄是 Seung Kim。Seung 是地方倡议支持联盟（Local Initiatives Support Coalition）的高级主任。

director.en: Dr Yvonne Pinto is Director General of the International Rice Research Institute, or IRRI for short, based in the Philippines.
director.zh: Yvonne Pinto 博士是总部位于菲律宾的国际水稻研究所（简称 IRRI）的所长。

director.en: Jean-Philippe Laborde, director of rice company, Tilda, thinks the answer lies in a new growing technique called Alternate Wet Drying, or AWD for short.
director.zh: 大米公司 Tilda 的总监 Jean-Philippe Laborde 认为，答案在于一种名为“间歇灌溉”（Alternate Wet Drying，简称 AWD）的新种植技术。

director.en: My name is Mike Francis. During the beginning of the mortgage implosion, I was an employee, executive director at Morgan Stanley on the residential mortgage trading desk.
director.zh: 我叫 Mike Francis。在抵押贷款崩溃的初期，我是摩根士丹利住宅抵押贷款交易台的一名员工、执行董事。

disappoint.en: It feels about as British as fish and chips, wet deckchairs and disappointing summer weather.
disappoint.zh: 这感觉就像炸鱼薯条、湿漉漉的沙滩椅和令人失望的夏天天气一样充满英国味。

disappoint.en: Here's Louise Mullany telling the story to BBC Radio 4's Word of Mouth: The cook looked so disappointed.
disappoint.zh: 下面是Louise Mullany向BBC第四广播台的《Word of Mouth》讲述这个故事：厨师看起来太失望了。

disappoint.en: Instead of ending the experiment, Zimbardo initially tried to convince him to stay, saying that leaving would disappoint the others.
disappoint.zh: Zimbardo 起初并没有终止实验，反而试图说服他留下来，说他离开会让其他人失望。

disappoint.en: You're disappointing me. I'm sad. I'm sad.
disappoint.zh: 你让我失望了。我很伤心。我很伤心。

disappoint.en: Because in some ways, now I feel like when the presentation happens, I'll be disappointed because I won't get to do this anymore.
disappoint.zh: 因为在某种程度上，我现在觉得当演讲结束时，我会感到失望，因为我不能再做这件事了。

direct.en: Protests erupted once again, but this time, they were directed at the new president.
direct.zh: 抗议活动再次爆发，但这一次，它们的矛头指向了新总统。

direct.en: But with no direct heirs, all eyes turned, yet again, to the next generation.
direct.zh: 但由于没有直系继承人，所有人的目光又一次转向了下一代。

direct.en: It is the direct result of decisions made just over a hundred years ago.
direct.zh: 它是 100 多年前所做决定的直接结果。

direct.en: And in 2020, it would get its own film version, directed by Ron Howard.
direct.zh: 并且在2020年，它被改编成同名电影，由朗·霍华德（Ron Howard）执导。

direct.en: He believed the Catholic population of Ireland was a direct threat to England's new republic.
direct.zh: 他认为爱尔兰的天主教人口对英格兰的新共和国构成了直接威胁。

disadvantage.en: How has it changed over time, and what do you think about its advantages and disadvantages?
disadvantage.zh: 随着时间的推移，它发生了怎样的变化？你如何看待它的优缺点？

disadvantage.en: And finally, something's pros and cons are its advantages and disadvantages.
disadvantage.zh: 最后，某事物的利弊（pros and cons）是它的优点和缺点。

disadvantage.en: But language learning has an interesting feature that I think people forget about: other students are not a disadvantage.
disadvantage.zh: 但语言学习有一个有趣的特点，我认为人们往往会忘记：其他学生并不是劣势。

disadvantage.en: We’ll discuss why having valuable natural resources can sometimes become a disadvantage and look at some of the world’s best-known examples.
disadvantage.zh: 我们将讨论为什么拥有宝贵的自然资源有时会成为一种劣势，并看一看世界上一些最著名的例子。

disadvantage.en: The pros and cons is another way of saying the advantages and disadvantages of something, especially when you're trying to choose between them.
disadvantage.zh: 利弊（pros and cons）是表达某事物的优点和缺点的另一种方式，尤其是当你试图在它们之间做出选择时。

divorce.en: She says a lack of communication is invariably - or always - the reason for divorce.
divorce.zh: 她说，缺乏沟通总是——或者一直是——离婚的原因。

divorce.en: In this programme we’ll be hearing how divorce is talked about in different countries.
divorce.zh: 在本期节目中，我们将聆听不同国家是如何讨论离婚的。

divorce.en: They both married someone called Linda and then divorced her for someone called Betty.
divorce.zh: 他们都娶了一个叫琳达的人，然后又为了一个叫贝蒂的人跟她离婚。

divorce.en: The average person is obese, likely to be divorced and has less than 1k in the bank.
divorce.zh: 普通人超重，很可能会离婚，而且银行存款不到1000美元。

divorce.en: His parents divorced when he was still a toddler.
divorce.zh: 在他还是个幼儿时，父母就离婚了。

distort.en: Something which is distorted has become misshapen so that it looks strange or unnatural.
distort.zh: distorted(扭曲的)指的是变得走形，看起来奇怪或不自然。

distort.en: Critics, on the other hand, say it’s unfair and distorts the democratic will.
distort.zh: 另一方面，批评者认为这很不公平，扭曲了民主意愿。

distort.en: Will's view of the world became distorted – twisted out of shape and unrealistic.
distort.zh: Will 对世界的看法变得扭曲(distorted)——也就是变形失真、脱离现实。

distort.en: It holds that individuals act rationally to pursue their goals, and that central planning or state intervention distorts prices and leads to inefficiency.
distort.zh: 该学派认为，个人会理性地采取行动以追求自己的目标，而中央计划或国家干预会扭曲价格并导致效率低下。

distort.en: On the right, there are those who oppose it because they see it as excessive government intervention in the free market, something that distorts natural supply and demand and risks killing jobs.
distort.zh: 在右翼，有人反对它，因为他们认为这是政府对自由市场的过度干预，扭曲了自然的供求关系，并有减少就业机会的风险。

disturb.en: Chimpanzees sleep around ten hours a night because their sleep is so frequently disturbed.
disturb.zh: 黑猩猩一晚睡大约十个小时，因为它们的睡眠经常被打断。

disturb.en: Plus, it can be emotionally disturbing deciding what to keep and what to throw away.
disturb.zh: 此外，决定留什么、扔什么可能会让人在情感上感到困扰。

disturb.en: Land was taken, hunting grounds were disturbed, and cultural practices were challenged.
disturb.zh: 土地被夺走，猎场遭到破坏，文化习俗受到挑战。

disturb.en: His last words are said to have been: “Let us now relieve the Romans from the fear which has long disturbed them.”
disturb.zh: 据说他的遗言是：“让我们为罗马人解除长久以来的恐惧吧。”

disturb.en: I've had many friends who won't go out with me in public because they go, hey, man, I want to have a meal and not be disturbed.
disturb.zh: 我有很多朋友不愿在公共场合和我一起出去，因为他们会说，嘿，伙计，我想吃顿饭，不想被打扰。

dictate.en: Korea has a complicated honorific system dictating how people above you in the social order should be addressed.
dictate.zh: 韩国有一个复杂的尊称系统，规定了如何称呼社会秩序中地位比你高的人。

dictate.en: He's still clinging to the dictates of a religion that forced him to deny his identity for two decades.
dictate.zh: 他依然死死抓住一个曾强迫他掩盖身份长达二十年的宗教的戒律不放。

dispose.en: Micheal was well disposed to the boy – he liked and approved of him.
dispose.zh: Michael对这个男孩很有好感——他喜欢并认可他。

dispose.en: You don't see him as insulting you, and you're actually quite kindly disposed to that person.
dispose.zh: 你并不认为他在侮辱你，实际上你对这个人抱有好感。

discourage.en: When cameras are visible on buildings or on lamp posts, they can discourage criminal behavior.
discourage.zh: 当摄像头显眼地安装在建筑物上或电线杆上时，它们可以起到威慑犯罪行为的作用。

discourage.en: For many years, the Rapa Nui language was discouraged or banned in schools.
discourage.zh: 多年来，Rapa Nui 语在学校里受到排挤或禁止使用。

discourage.en: This was part of a government strategy to discourage illegal immigration, to discourage illegal arrivals by boat.
discourage.zh: 这是政府阻止非法移民、阻止乘船非法入境策略的一部分。

discourage.en: This was part of a government strategy to discourage illegal immigration, to discourage illegal arrivals by boat.
discourage.zh: 这是政府阻止非法移民、阻止乘船非法入境策略的一部分。

discourage.en: An infamous example is the Chinese Head Tax, which was introduced in the late 19th century to discourage Chinese immigration.
discourage.zh: 一个声名狼籍的例子就是“人头税”（Chinese Head Tax），这是在19世纪后期引入的，旨在阻碍华人移民。

diagnose.en: And my friend got diagnosed first, told me about it, changed his whole life.
diagnose.zh: 你是什么时候发现自己有ADHD的？我两年前被诊断出来的。

diagnose.en: When did you find out you had ADHD? I got diagnosed two years ago.
diagnose.zh: 我们听到了。你知道吗？你说你的心理咨询师或心理咨询帮助你确定了ADHD和抑郁症之间的联系。

diagnose.en: To diagnose means to identify a disease or health problem through medical examination.
diagnose.zh: 诊断的意思是通过医学检查来确定疾病或健康问题。

diagnose.en: To diagnose a disease or medical condition means to identify it by recognising the symptoms and examining the patient.
diagnose.zh: Diagnose（诊断）一种疾病或健康状况，意味着通过识别症状和检查患者来确定病情。

diagnose.en: By 1917, his health had begun to fail. He was diagnosed with several illnesses, including tuberculosis and vitamin deficiencies, and he spent long periods recovering in hospitals.
diagnose.zh: 到1917年，他的健康状况开始恶化。他被诊断出患有多种疾病，包括结核病和维生素缺乏症，并在医院里度过了漫长的康复期。

displace.en: It's going to displace workers… you know, eventually, in the near future.
displace.zh: 它将取代工人……你知道的，最终，在不久的将来。

displace.en: It displaces people and it collapses economies.
displace.zh: 它使人流离失所，并导致经济崩溃。

displace.en: Mylene emphasises her fears about being replaced by giving details about a study she read, which claimed that 27% of workers will be displaced by AI.
displace.zh: Mylene通过提供她读过的一项研究的细节来强调她对被取代的恐惧，该研究称27%的工人将被AI取代。

displace.en: What followed, as you will know, was a brutal war that has displaced millions, caused tens of thousands of deaths, and left parts of Ukraine in ruins.
displace.zh: 正如你所知，随之而来的是一场残酷的战争，数百万人流离失所，数万人死亡，乌克兰部分地区沦为废墟。

displace.en: As European colonies expanded over the following centuries, more and more indigenous peoples were displaced, kicked out of their lands, and their independence was taken away from them.
displace.zh: 随着欧洲殖民地在接下来的几个世纪里不断扩张，越来越多的原住民流离失所，被驱逐出自己的土地，他们的独立也遭到了剥夺。

diagram.en: These were filled with sketches and diagrams and observations.
diagram.zh: 这些笔记本里填满了草图、图表和观察结果。

diagram.en: Well done! Right, let's recap the vocabulary we've learned starting with family tree, a diagram showing all the members of a family Ancestry refers to the origins of a family.
diagram.zh: 干得好！好，让我们回顾一下我们学过的词汇，首先是“家谱”（family tree），一张显示家族所有成员的图表。“祖先”（Ancestry）指的是家族的起源。

diagram.en: I'm Neil. And I'm Beth. Nowadays, it's popular to find out more about your family history by tracing your family tree – a diagram that shows all the members of a family over a long period of time.
diagram.zh: 我是尼尔。我是贝丝。如今，通过追溯家谱——一种展示一个家族在漫长时间里所有成员的图表——来了解更多家族历史非常流行。

disk.en: Can you remember when computer floppy disks, hand-held Game Boys, and fax machines were in fashion?
disk.zh: 你还记得电脑软盘、手掌游戏机Game Boy和传真机风靡一时的时代吗？

disk.en: So, you might be surprised to hear that until recently the government of Japan still used three and-a-half inch floppy disks to store official documents; that around the world, music cassettes and Walkmans are making a comeback; and that even the world-famous Swiss CERN physics laboratory uses old-fashioned magnetic tape reels to record its data.
disk.zh: 所以，听到以下这些消息你可能会感到惊讶：直到最近，日本政府仍在使用3.5英寸软盘来存储官方文件；在世界各地，音乐磁带和Walkman正在卷土重来；甚至世界著名的瑞士CERN物理实验室也在使用老式的磁带盘来记录数据。

diverse.en: Canada is one of the most ethnically and culturally diverse societies in the world.
diverse.zh: 加拿大是世界上种族和文化最多元化的社会之一。

diverse.en: Canada’s population was really diverse, especially by the standards of the time.
diverse.zh: 加拿大的多元人口结构在当时的标准来看确实十分丰富。

diverse.en: Darwin studied finches, small birds with surprisingly diverse beak shapes.
diverse.zh: Darwin研究了雀类（finches），这是一种喙部形状出奇多样的小鸟。

diverse.en: It is a diverse city with African and European influences.
diverse.zh: 这是一座融合了非洲和欧洲影响的多元化城市。

diverse.en: This was the most diverse part of British North America.
diverse.zh: 这是英属北美最多元化的地区。

distinguish.en: A colour-blind person is unable to distinguish certain colours especially greens and reds.
distinguish.zh: 色盲(colour-blind)的人无法分辨某些颜色，尤其是绿色和红色。

distinguish.en: The anthropologist Edward T. Hall introduced another useful way of distinguishing between cultures.
distinguish.zh: 人类学家爱德华·T·霍尔（Edward T. Hall）提出了另一种区分文化的有用方法。

distinguish.en: Everywhere he went, he distinguished himself.
distinguish.zh: 无论走到哪里，他都表现出色。

distinguish.en: How to distinguish evidence from opinion.
So that’s why we need to distinguish between “confidence” and “overconfidence.” Overconfidence is when someone’s belief in their ability is higher than their actual ability.
distinguish.zh: 这就是为什么我们需要区分“自信”与“过度自信”。过度自信是指一个人对自己能力的信念高于其实际能力。

digest.en: Is clay good for: a) curing headaches? b) digesting food? or, c) smoothing face skin?
digest.zh: 粘土有何妙用：a) 治疗头痛？b) 消化食物？还是 c) 平滑面部皮肤？

digest.en: His argument is this. Raw food is hard to digest.
digest.zh: 他的论点是这样的。生食很难消化。

digest.en: Scientists have discovered that one of the biggest genetic differences between a wolf and a dog is the ability to digest starch, the carbohydrate you get from eating things like bread, rice and potatoes.
digest.zh: 科学家们发现，狼和狗之间最大的基因差异之一，在于消化淀粉的能力——淀粉也就是你从面包、大米和土豆等食物中摄入的碳水化合物。

distribute.en: The Christian Bible is often considered the most distributed or the best-selling book in history.
distribute.zh: 基督教的《圣经》通常被认为是历史上发行量最大或最畅销的书籍。

distribute.en: From WBEZ Chicago, it's This American Life, distributed by Public Radio International.
distribute.zh: 来自芝加哥 WBEZ 电台，这是由美国公共广播电台发行的《This American Life》。

distribute.en: Some books were copied and distributed for years before any records exist.
distribute.zh: 有些书籍在任何记录出现之前就已经被抄写并流传了多年。

distribute.en: And we already have, as you said, 10% of the population taking them, so they're already quite widely distributed.
distribute.zh: 正如你所说，我们已经有10%的人口在使用它们，所以它们已经相当普及了。

distribute.en: It appears to be broadly distributed across ordinary human beings, regardless of nationality, education, or personal decency.
distribute.zh: 它似乎广泛存在于普通人之中，无关国籍、教育程度，也无关个人品行的好坏。

discharge.en: But you had to give notice, and in many cases wait twenty-four hours before being discharged.
discharge.zh: 但你必须提前通知，并且在许多情况下需要等待二十四小时才能被释放。

diary.en: As was the norm with Victorian explorers, he recorded everything in a diary, and published it on his return.
diary.zh: 正如维多利亚时代探险家的常态一样，他在日记中记录了一切，并在归来后将其出版。

diary.en: It's like, I like Rick's framework that like, if you look at your work, it's just like an entry to a diary.
diary.zh: 就像，我喜欢Rick的框架，即如果你审视你的工作，它就像日记的一页。

diary.en: For nearly a decade he kept a detailed personal diary that recorded everything he ate, drank, gossiped about, and went to see.
diary.zh: 近十年来，他坚持写详细的个人日记，记录了他吃过的每一顿饭、喝过的每一杯酒、听到过的每一桩八卦以及看过的每一场演出。

diary.zh: ‘真实’是一个复杂的词，但你和任何人所能期望的一样真实。这就是为什么每个人都必须去听你的播客，这是我放在下面的第三个链接，它叫《What Now》。嗯，这是我最喜欢的播客之一。Trevor，非常感谢你，来自那个制作了绝对是史上最好播客之一的人。非常感谢。不，不，我是认真的，我是认真的。你知道，我总是说，如果你想看一个专业的播客，去听《Diary of a CEO》；如果你想来探索我的思想，来听《What Now》。人们想探索你的思想。不，我是认真的，祝贺你。我很感激你，非常感谢。我无法告诉你这是一种多么大的荣幸。有时采访别人我会很紧张，而你……哦，哇，谢谢。我也很紧张，因为我非常尊重你，所以非常感谢你的时间，我很感激你。是的，伙计，别花那么多时间独处。你不是……你知道，我知道你一直都在那里，我知道在某种奇怪的方式下，它感觉像是一个舒适的地方，但它不需要是这样。我正在学习这一点。是的，你会惊讶于它另一面有多少东西，你知道，在某种奇怪的方式下，你会惊讶于找到那种归属感能为你做什么。

dispatch.en: His readers had no idea they were reading dispatches from the King of Great Britain.
dispatch.zh: 他的读者根本不知道他们读的是大不列颠国王发出的消息。

dispute.en: You go there with your family. Any dispute, you go and talk about it there.
dispute.zh: 你和家人一起去。任何纠纷，你都会去那里谈论。

dispute.en: Disputes over who actually owned what would simmer for generations.
dispute.zh: 关于谁到底拥有什么的争端持续了好几代人。

dispute.en: Its exact origins are disputed, but it’s generally understood to be a product of the British Indian restaurant tradition.
dispute.zh: 它的确切起源尚存争议，但人们普遍认为它是英式印度餐厅传统的产物。

dispute.en: What happened next is disputed in almost every account.
dispute.zh: 接下来发生的事情，几乎在每一份记述中都存在争议。

dispute.en: But here is what is not in dispute: we are the only animal on earth that cooks its food.
dispute.zh: 但有一点是无可争议的：我们是地球上唯一烹饪食物的动物。

distant.en: Mapping distant frontiers, after all, was often as politically useful as it was scientifically exciting.
distant.zh: 毕竟，绘制遥远边疆的地图通常在政治上和在科学上一样有用。

distant.en: Although geographically distant from Australia, Christmas Island has been an external territory of Australia since 1958.
distant.zh: 尽管在地理上距离澳大利亚较远，但自 1958 年以来，圣诞岛一直是澳大利亚的一个海外领地。

distant.en: They followed ocean currents and wave patterns that reflected off distant islands.
distant.zh: 他们追随洋流和从远方岛屿反射回来的波浪模式。

distant.en: According to their own legends, they came from a distant, possibly mythical homeland called Aztlán.
distant.zh: 根据他们自己的传说，他们来自一个遥远、甚至可能是神话中的故乡，名叫阿兹特兰。

distant.en: They let us think about distant places and people, past events, and futures that have not yet happened.
distant.zh: 它们让我们思考遥远的地方和人物、过去的事件，以及尚未发生的未来。

dimension.en: Most emotions and feeling states can be mapped onto those dimensions.
dimension.zh: 大多数情绪和感受状态，都可以被映射到这两个维度上。

dimension.en: There is also an important international dimension.
dimension.zh: 这里还有一个重要的国际维度。

dimension.en: And, mobile telephony is just one technology that really originated across multiple dimensions, not just the transistor, but the network and extension.
dimension.zh: 而移动通信其实只是众多维度共同孕育出的一项技术之一，不只是晶体管，还包括网络和延伸应用。

dimension.en: We don't see the way in which we have improved across multiple dimensions, not just efficiency dimensions, but also ethical dimensions, as you were just referencing.
dimension.zh: 我们往往看不到自己已经在多个维度上取得了进步——不只是效率维度，正如你刚才提到的，还包括伦理维度。

dimension.en: Can I identify where emotion words might fit into an emotion space defined by pleasant and unpleasant dimension and an active versus calm dimension?
dimension.zh: 我能不能判断出某个情绪词，在一个以“愉悦-不愉悦”维度和“活跃-平静”维度所定义的情绪空间里，应该被放在什么位置？

disable.en: Shotgun blasts hit his left arm. He survived, but his arm was permanently disabled.
disable.zh: 霰弹枪击中了他的左臂，他保住了性命，但左臂从此终身残废。

disable.en: Another left a university professor permanently disabled.
disable.zh: 还有一枚让一名大学教授终身残疾。

dissolve.en: Abdallah is put on a plane to Paris. His government is dissolved.
dissolve.zh: Ahmed Abdallah 被塞上一架飞往巴黎的飞机。他的政府被解散。

dissolve.en: So he dissolved parliament, banned all political parties, and declared that for the next five years, there would only be one voice in the Congo: his.
dissolve.zh: 于是他解散了议会，取缔了所有政党，并宣布在接下来的五年里，刚果只能有一个声音：那就是他的声音。

dissolve.en: But the monarch still technically appoints the Prime Minister, opens Parliament, dissolves Parliament, meets the Prime Minister every week to discuss the state of the country, and gives the final say on any new laws.
dissolve.zh: 但君主在技术上仍然任命首相、开闭议会、每周与首相会面讨论国家状况，并对任何新法律拥有最终决定权。

district.en: One district voted 80% for the Republicans and 20% for the Democrats in the last election.
district.zh: 在最近的一次选举中，第一个选区有80%的人投给共和党，20%的人投给民主党。

district.en: Wall Street refers to the economic center of New York, the financial district.
district.zh: 华尔街指代纽约的经济中心、金融区。

district.en: One is Border Districts. The other Stream System-- The Collected Short Fiction of Gerald Murnane.
district.zh: 一部是《边境地区》。另一部是《溪流系统——Gerald Murnane短篇小说集》。

district.en: As the port expanded, new commercial districts were built around the port.
district.zh: 随着港口的扩大，港口周围建起了新的商业区。

district.en: You could change these districts. Because they’re next to each other, you could redraw the map.
district.zh: 你可以改变这些选区。因为它们相邻，所以你可以重新绘制地图。

divine.en: A king ruled by divine right. Courts relied on Christian oaths.
divine.zh: 君王凭借神权统治。法庭依靠基督教誓言运作。

divine.en: The one time I've had divine inspiration, three in the morning, wake up with the name was Modern Wisdom.
divine.zh: 只有那一次，我有过神来之笔，凌晨三点醒来想到的名字是Modern Wisdom。

divine.en: And even the dead wore perfume. The mummification process involved covering bodies in frankincense, myrrh, and aromatic oils, not just for preservation, but so that the dead would smell divine in the afterlife.
divine.zh: 甚至死者也使用香水。木乃伊制作过程包括将尸体涂上乳香、没药和芳香油，不仅为了防腐，还为了让死者在来世闻起来像神一样芬芳。

disregard.en: This was a man who revelled in public humiliation, showed little regard for human life, and held his elected officials in utter disregard.
disregard.zh: 这是一个以公开羞辱他人为乐、对人命漠不关心、对elected officials极端蔑视的人。

disregard.en: They simply didn’t accept it. Even disregarding the content of the confession, and with our “English learner’s” hat on, the language was as if it had been written by a non-native speaker.
disregard.zh: 他们根本不接受这份供词。就算撇开供词的内容不谈，戴上我们"英语学习者"的帽子来看，这段话的用词读起来就像是出自一个非母语者之手。

disregard.en: These are unteachable lessons. No matter how arduous or costly or effortful it is going to be for us to find out ourselves, we prefer to disregard the mountains of warnings from our elders, songs, literature, historical catastrophes, public scandals, and instead think some version of, yeah, that might be true for them, but not for me.
disregard.zh: 这些就是无法传授的课程。无论我们自己去发现它会有多么艰苦、昂贵或费力，我们都宁愿无视长辈、歌曲、文学、历史灾难、公共丑闻中堆积如山的警告，反而想出某种版本的：是的，那对他们来说可能是真的，但对我来说不是。

diplomatic.en: And the city hosted royal ceremonies, diplomatic events if other countries’ leaders came to visit.
diplomatic.zh: 这座城市还举办了皇家典礼，以及其他国家领导人来访时的外交活动。

diplomatic.en: In workplaces, they can help you sound more polite and diplomatic.
diplomatic.zh: 在职场中，它们可以帮助你显得更礼貌、更有外交辞令。

diplomatic.en: The United States has never had formal diplomatic relations with North Korea, and the two countries are still technically at war.
diplomatic.zh: 美国从未与朝鲜建立过正式外交关系，严格来说，两国至今仍处于战争状态。

diplomatic.en: They can also make your language sound more professional or diplomatic, which is why they’re so common in workplaces and news reports and politics.
diplomatic.zh: 它们还能让你的语言听起来更专业或更有外交辞令感，这就是为什么它们在职场、新闻报道和政治中如此常见。

diplomatic.en: Through a series of carefully planned wars and diplomatic moves, Prussia defeated its rivals and positioned itself as the leader of a new German nation.
diplomatic.zh: 通过一系列精心策划的战争和外交行动，普鲁士击败了对手，并将自己定位为新德国的领导者。

distract.en: Distracting. Yeah. You know, like Chris Pratt with those raptors in Jurassic Park.
distract.zh: 分散注意力。是的。你知道，就像《侏罗纪公园》里克里斯·帕拉特（Chris Pratt）对付那些迅猛龙一样。

distract.en: How should people learn to get less distracted by status games in that way?
distract.zh: 人们应该如何学会不那么被这类的地位游戏所分心呢？

distract.en: At some point, the experimenters just felt sorry for them and decided to distract them with a movie.
distract.zh: 在某个时刻，实验人员实在觉得他们怪可怜的，决定用一部电影来分散他们的注意力。

distract.en: Just how brief it is that the time that you spend ruminating, being distracted, fears of the past, regrets.
distract.zh: 仅仅是因为它太短暂了，你花在反刍、分心、对过去的恐惧、后悔上的时间。

distract.en: You know, in some sense, you'd think, given that they cannot eat, they'd rather be distracted with other things.
distract.zh: 你知道，从某种意义上说，你可能会想，既然他们吃不到东西，他们宁愿用别的事来转移注意力。

diversify.en: To prepare for that possibility, the government has started to diversify its economy.
diversify.zh: 为了防范这种可能性，政府已经开始实现经济多元化。

diversify.en: By contrast, countries with diversified economies, economies that produce many different goods and services, are much more resilient, much stronger.
diversify.zh: 相比之下，经济多元化的国家——即生产许多不同商品和服务的经济体——要坚韧得多，强大得多。

diversify.en: For the first time ever, it seemed as though Saudi Arabia was on the cusp of reinventing itself entirely—modernising socially, diversifying economically, and becoming a hub for futuristic projects.
diversify.zh: 有史以来第一次，沙特阿拉伯似乎正处于彻底重塑自己的边缘——实现社会现代化、经济多元化，并成为未来派项目的中心。

dialect.en: Let’s start by going back to 2005. That year, the American Dialect Society chose the word “truthiness”.
dialect.zh: 我们先回到 2005 年。那一年，美国方言学会选出的词是“truthiness”。

dialect.en: It could involve switching dialects. For example, using regional vocabulary or pronunciation depending on who you’re talking to.
dialect.zh: 它可能涉及方言的切换。例如，根据你正在交谈的对象使用区域词汇或发音。

dialect.en: This is obvious when you think about some of the differences between idioms used in different dialects of English as well.
dialect.zh: 当你思考英语不同方言所使用的习语之间的一些差异时，这一点就很明显了。

dialect.en: In several northern dialects speakers drop the direct article, or just shorten it to “t”, so instead of saying “in the bath”, they might say “in’t bath”.
dialect.zh: 在几种北方方言中，说话者会省略定冠词，或者将其缩略为“t”，所以他们不说“in the bath”，而是可能会说成“in’t bath”。

dialect.en: What’s more, in several northern dialects people will drop the “h” at the start of a word, saying “ave” instead of “have”, “art” instead of “heart”, and so on.
dialect.zh: 不仅如此，在几种北方方言中，人们还会省略词首的“h”音，把“have”说成“ave”，把“heart”说成“art”，等等。

distinction.en: The distinction between UNESCO heritage sites and the New Seven Wonders is important.
distinction.zh: UNESCO遗产地与新世界七大奇迹之间的区别很重要。

distinction.en: One important distinction is between online learning in general and what’s called synchronous online language teaching.
distinction.zh: 一个重要的区别是一般的在线学习和所谓的同步在线语言教学。

distinction.en: Now, this is an important distinction to make.
distinction.zh: 现在，这是一个需要做出的重要区别。

distinction.en: This distinction, the difference between ability and performance, is important because we often judge people based on what we see.
distinction.zh: 这种区分——能力与表现的区别——非常重要，因为我们经常根据看到的情况来评判他人。

distinction.en: When we’re interested in language learning, that distinction is important because interaction is a incredibly important part of language practice.
distinction.zh: 当我们对语言学习感兴趣时，这种区别很重要，因为互动是语言练习中极其重要的一部分。

disclose.en: They shouldn’t disclose any classified information, and simple bullet points were fine.
disclose.zh: 他们不应泄露任何机密信息，简单的要点即可。

dilute.en: Their votes are diluted, made weak, so they are unlikely to have a majority in any district.
dilute.zh: 他们的选票被稀释、被削弱，因此他们在任何选区都不太可能占据多数。

dilute.en: And while supporters framed this reform as modern, inclusive, and pragmatic, opponents presented it as rushed, dangerous, and as something that could erode and dilute Italian identity.
dilute.zh: 虽然支持者将这场改革描绘成现代、包容和务实的，但反对者却将其视为仓促、危险的举动，并认为这可能会侵蚀和稀释意大利人的身份认同。

dismay.en: The result was met with cheers by Meloni and her supporters on the right, and with dismay by those who had campaigned for the referendum, who were mainly on the political left.
dismay.zh: 这一结果迎来了 Meloni 及其右翼支持者的欢呼，却让那些为公投奔走呼号、主要来自政治左翼的人士感到沮丧。

disobedience.en: He was known for all sorts of pranks, tricks on his Catholic school teachers, and with age, these turned from classroom jokes into more serious acts of disobedience.
disobedience.zh: 他以各种恶作剧闻名，捉弄天主教学校的老师，随着年龄的增长，这些课堂上的玩笑演变成了更严重的违纪行为。

diamond.en: One very famous example is the Diamond Sutra, a Buddhist text printed in 868 CE.
diamond.zh: 一个非常著名的例子就是《金刚经》，这是一部在公元868年印刷的佛教经典。

diamond.en: Different governments have invested their diamond revenues into infrastructure and healthcare and education.
diamond.zh: 不同的政府将钻石收入投资于基础设施、医疗保健和教育。

diamond.en: Beneath the DRC lies enormous deposits of copper, cobalt, gold, diamonds, tin, and coltan.
diamond.zh: 刚果（金）地下蕴藏着巨额的铜、钴、黄金、钻石、锡和钶钽铁矿储量。

diamond.en: The Democratic Republic of Congo is one of the wealthiest countries in the world in terms of its natural resources, with huge deposits of copper, cobalt, gold, diamonds, and other precious metals.
diamond.zh: 就自然资源而言，刚果民主共和国是世界上最富有的国家之一，拥有巨额的铜、钴、金、钻石和其他贵金属储量。

diamond.en: In Africa, Wagner has operated in countries like Libya, Sudan, and the Central African Republic, providing security for unstable governments in exchange for access to valuable resources such as gold and diamonds.
diamond.zh: 在非洲，瓦格纳在利比亚、苏丹和中非共和国等国家活动，向不稳定的政府提供安保，以换取获得黄金和钻石等宝贵资源的途径。

disperse.en: But unlike previous protests, the demonstrators didn’t disperse.
disperse.zh: 但与以往的抗议不同，示威者并没有散去。

disperse.en: Mobutu ruled through a complex web of patronage, of dispersing power, favours and money to his family, friends and allies.
disperse.zh: 蒙博托通过复杂的裙带关系网络进行统治，将权力、恩惠和金钱分发给他的家人、朋友和盟友。

disgrace.en: He arrived in Rabat as a disgraced former leader, his entourage vastly reduced, his fortune frozen or looted.
disgrace.zh: 他以一个失势的前领导人身份抵达拉巴特，随行人员寥寥无几，财富被冻结或遭洗劫。

dignity.en: And the demands of protestors are often simple and repeated across history… fairness, dignity, and a voice.
dignity.zh: 而抗议者的诉求往往很简单，并在历史上不断重复……公平、尊严和话语权。

dignity.en: I think the simplest definition of poverty is not having enough resources, money, or food or shelter, to live with dignity.
dignity.zh: 我认为，贫困最简单的定义就是没有足够的资源、金钱、食物或住所来维持有尊严的生活。

dignity.en: It doesn't take your dignity away. It's just walking alongside, and how can, you know, together strategize to meet your goals?
dignity.zh: 它不会剥夺你的尊严。它只是并肩同行，思考如何才能，你知道的，共同制定策略来达成你的目标？

dignity.en: On the left, there are those who support it because it protects vulnerable workers, reduces inequality, and ensures a basic level of dignity in work.
dignity.zh: 在左翼，有人支持它，因为它保护了弱势工人，减少了不平等，并确保了工作的基本尊严。

dictator.en: The crowds in Tahrir Square danced and cheered, the dictator was gone.
dictator.zh: 解放广场上的人群载歌载舞，欢呼雀跃，独裁者倒台了。

dictator.en: Ancient leaders, medieval kings and 20th century dictators all used false information to influence people.
dictator.zh: 古代的统治者、中世纪的国王以及20世纪的独裁者都曾利用虚假信息来影响民众。

dictator.en: Sani Abacha was the military dictator of Nigeria from 1993 to 1998.
dictator.zh: 萨尼·阿巴查是尼日利亚从1993年到1998年的军事独裁者。

dictator.en: A dictator who had ruled for 23 years, brought down by the power of a single act of defiance.
dictator.zh: 一个统治了 23 年的独裁者，被一个反抗之举的力量所击倒。

dictator.en: He might have been draconian at times, he has been called a dictator, but it is hard to argue that anybody is more deserving of the title “The father of modern Turkey”.
dictator.zh: 他有时可能会很严厉，甚至被人称为独裁者，但很难辩驳有谁比他更配得上“现代土耳其之父”这个称号。

discard.en: And it could do it in just a few seconds and then discard them.
discard.zh: 而且它能在短短几秒钟内完成并将其排除。

discard.en: The Arabs were to be used, plain and simple, and once they had done their job and caused enough disruption to the Ottomans, they would be discarded.
discard.zh: 简单来说，阿拉伯人就是被利用的工具，一旦他们完成了任务，对奥斯曼人造成了足够的破坏，就会被抛弃。

distil.en: They're very bad at actually distilling the essence of something and what's important.
distil.zh: 他们非常不擅长真正提炼事物的本质和什么是重要的。

distil.en: You can thank me later. You're like, that is distilled down.
distil.zh: 你以后可以感谢我。你就像是说，那被提炼出来了。

distil.en: They would extract the fragrant oils from flowers, resins, and spices, and distil them to leave only the best-smelling scents.
distil.zh: 他们从花朵、树脂和香料中提取芳香精油，并将其蒸馏，只留下气味最好的成分。

disastrous.en: It was a disastrous decision, the nail in the coffin for the sick man of Europe.
disastrous.zh: 这是一个灾难性的决定，是压垮欧洲病夫的最后一根稻草。

disappearance.en: So this was the backdrop to the “disappearance” of John Stonehouse.
disappearance.zh: 这就是 John Stonehouse “失踪”的背景。

disappearance.en: Amidst this backdrop of turmoil, two high-profile disappearances captured the public’s imagination and dominated newspaper headlines.
disappearance.zh: 在这种动荡的背景下，两起备受瞩目的失踪案引发了公众的无限遐想，并占据了报纸头条。

disappearance.en: Their disappearance ignited a feverish obsession.
disappearance.zh: 他们的失踪引发了一种狂热的痴迷。

discrepancy.en: Over time, the slight discrepancy between 365 days and the true length of the solar year added up, causing the calendar to drift out of sync with the seasons.
discrepancy.zh: 随着时间的推移，365 天与太阳年真实长度之间的微小差异累积起来，导致日历与季节逐渐脱节。

discrepancy.en: And so for me, the only version of acceptance that I have is that I accept that the version of myself that I want to be is so far from who I am, that I have this massive discrepancy that I have to overcome.
discrepancy.zh: 所以对我来说，我唯一认可的接纳是：我接纳我理想中的自己与现在的我之间差距巨大，我必须克服这个巨大的鸿沟。

discrepancy.en: And people talk a lot about like trauma and improvement and stuff like that. self-love is holding yourself to a higher standard than anyone else does that's really interesting to me i think it's believing in the 85 year old version of you who's exactly who you want to be and then ruthlessly looking at the discrepancy between the pittance of a human that you are now compared to that man or that woman.
discrepancy.zh: 人们经常谈论创伤、自我提升之类的话题。对我来说，真正的自爱是给自己设定比任何人都高的标准，这非常有意思。我认为，自爱就是去相信那个85岁的自己——那个你理想中的样子，然后无情地审视现在的你与那个男人或女人之间那点可怜的差距。

ditch.en: And he wasn’t operating in the shadows, hiding in ditches or secretly breaking into apartments to gain intelligence.
ditch.zh: 而且他并不是在阴影中行动，躲在壕沟里或秘密潜入公寓去获取情报。

diameter.en: Asteroids are smaller, typically ranging from a few hundred metres or so through to the largest known asteroid, which is almost 1,000 kilometres in diameter, around the same width as France from its most northern to most southern point.
diameter.zh: 小行星较小，直径通常从几百米不等，一直到已知最大的一颗小行星——它的直径接近 1,000 公里，大致相当于法国从最北端到最南端的宽度。

diminish.en: Countries invested in their own steel and coal industries, and there was a diminishing need for British products.
diminish.zh: 各国纷纷投资本国的钢铁和煤炭产业，对英国产品的需求也日渐减少。

diminish.en: The goal is to alert pilots when they've made a mistake and to diminish the consequences of mistakes.
diminish.zh: 目标是在飞行员犯错时发出警报，并减轻错误带来的后果。

diminish.en: So I'm always cautious to think of that because it doesn't, like I say, it doesn't diminish what you've done.
diminish.zh: 所以我总是谨慎地思考这一点，因为它不会，就像我说的，它不会削弱你所做的事情。

diminish.en: Your ability to be surprised actually diminishes.
diminish.zh: 你被惊喜的能力实际上减少了。

diminish.en: And I don't think it diminishes your achievement.
diminish.zh: 我不认为这削弱了你的成就。

distinctly.en: Italian immigrants moved to the US, transformed the dish pizza to a new style, created New York and Chicago pizzas that are now distinctly American.
distinctly.zh: 意大利移民移居美国，将披萨这道菜转变为一种新的风格，创造了现在具有鲜明美国特色的纽约披萨和芝加哥披萨。

distinct.en: Of course, some Japanese people do struggle with L, R distinctions because these sounds are not distinct in Japanese, but that does not mean they can’t improve, they can’t learn, or they can’t develop.
distinct.zh: 当然，有些日本人确实在 L 和 R 的区分上感到吃力，因为这些音在日语中没有区别，但这并不意味着他们不能进步、不能学习或不能发展。

discrimination.en: Turing’s story is a reminder that brilliance does not protect someone from discrimination.
discrimination.zh: Turing 的故事提醒我们，绝顶的才华并不能保护一个人免受歧视。

discrimination.en: While indigenous people and enslaved Africans usually lived in poverty and faced harsh discrimination.
discrimination.zh: 而土著人民和被奴役的非洲人通常生活在贫困之中，并面临着严重的歧视。

discrimination.en: Many groups have faced major discrimination in the USA in the past, and today as well.
discrimination.zh: 在过去以及今天，许多群体都在美国遭遇过严重的歧视。

discrimination.en: Discrimination, for example, can limit people’s access to education or jobs.
discrimination.zh: 例如，歧视会限制人们获得教育或工作的机会。

discrimination.en: But as we’ve seen throughout this episode, poverty is often caused by other factors like low wages or poor health, or lack of education, discrimination, natural disasters, or conflict.
discrimination.zh: 但正如我们在本集节目中所看到的，贫困通常是由其他因素引起的，比如低工资、健康状况不佳、缺乏教育、歧视、自然灾害或冲突。

dissatisfy.en: People were dissatisfied. Economic stagnation and the lack of freedom, and also some of the reforms in the Soviet Union, frustrated East German people.
dissatisfy.zh: 人们感到不满。经济停滞、缺乏自由，以及苏联的一些改革，让东德人感到沮丧。

distribution.en: The benefits of societal distribution of the safer GLP-1s is so large that whichever politicians tackles that is going to be richly rewarded.
distribution.zh: 社会化分发更安全的GLP-1类药物所带来的益处是巨大的，任何解决这个问题的政客都将获得丰厚的回报。

distribution.en: The lived experience of a consumer in really what is, on average, the top 5% of the global income distribution, is not the same as it is for the other 95%, and certainly not for the bottom quartile.
distribution.zh: 一个平均处于全球收入分布前5%的消费者的生活体验，和其余95%的人是不一样的，跟收入最低的四分之一人群相比更是天壤之别。

diligent.en: I would describe him as obsessive. You know, he's really perfectionist, willing to do whatever it takes for it to be great. and diligent, hardworking.
diligent.zh: 我会形容他为强迫症。你知道，他真的是个完美主义者，愿意为了做到极致而付出一切。而且勤奋、努力。

diligent.en: And so, there's a lot of ways that very creative, diligent, imaginative people can devote their efforts that are net destructive or, at best, indifferent to human wellbeing.
diligent.zh: 所以，那些极具创造力、勤奋且富有想象力的人，其实有很多种方式可以把精力投入到对人类福祉毫无益处、甚至是净破坏性的事情上去。

dissatisfaction.zh: 成功来自于不满足。那成功还值得吗？
